item.title: Podcow Global AI Daily: Friday, September 18, 2026
item.description: Today's AI landscape is marked by intensifying debates over safety governance as Anthropic's CEO proposes an international framework to pace frontier development. Concurrently, tangible security risks have escalated following reports that researchers successfully utilized Claude to compromise an OpenAI employee account. Meanwhile, the strategic influence of the AI sector is expanding rapidly into both consumer households with Google's new coordinator agent, and federal politics through targeted PAC campaign spending.
